payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each starting station, compute max over stations: dist(start, s) + (cnt_s - 1)*n + min_dist(s, destinations). Greedy: deliver closest destination last to minimize added time.
payload.rationale: Uses exchange argument: for candies from same station, order doesn't affect total except the last candy, so choose the one with smallest distance to save time. No complete search or other greedy constructions.
